gloss: to devote oneself to, to work hard at

definitions.gloss: to devote oneself to, to work hard at, to strive
definitions.explanation: To apply oneself diligently to a task or pursuit. Takes に to mark the activity one is devoted to.

examples.japanese: {勉強|べんきょう}に{励|はげ}む。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{毎日|まいにち}{練習|れんしゅう}に{励|はげ}んでいる。
examples.english: She works hard at practice every day.

examples.japanese: {選手|せんしゅ}たちは{優勝|ゆうしょう}を{目指|めざ}して{日々|ひび}トレーニングに{励|はげ}んでいる。
examples.english: The athletes work hard at training every day, aiming for the championship.

notes:
Godan verb (む row: {励|はげ}む → {励|はげ}まない → {励|はげ}んで). Takes the pattern ～に{励|はげ}む (to devote oneself to ~). The activity one works on is marked with に.

Not to be confused with the transitive form {励|はげ}ます (to encourage someone).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{勉強|べんきょう}に{励|はげ}む — to devote oneself to study
・{仕事|しごと}に{励|はげ}む — to work hard at one's job
・{練習|れんしゅう}に{励|はげ}む — to work hard at practice
・{研究|けんきゅう}に{励|はげ}む — to devote oneself to research
